holdout_transfer.note: Not in the registry. Same law pair as click@c53d373, different function (`Option.get_error_hint`), 35 candidates offered. Evidence the mechanisms generalise to unseen commits rather than memorising registered ones.

click@047adef.needed_law: set(x) -> dict.fromkeys(x) when the returned order is the contract
click@047adef.why_refused: The counter-idiom exists in the baseline (src/click/types.py:420 uses dict.fromkeys for order-preserving dedup), but no statement anywhere in the parent tree declares that help-option-name order is a contract. set() reproduces the parent's own behaviour exactly, so firing here would be a guess, not an inference.

click@7996a89.multi_file_caveat: The real commit touches 6 files, but a MEASURED minimal patch changing ONLY `formatting.py` (adding both kwargs) takes the suite from 10 failed/37 passed to 47 passed. So this wall is NOT evidence that multi-file coupling is required; the other files were cleanup. The multi-file zipper was not needed and was not credited here.
click@7996a89.why_open: The repository states `break_on_hyphens=False` for itself in utils.py, and CONFIG_PARITY_FROM_REPO_IDIOM lifts it into formatting.py, closing 2 of 10 failures. The remaining two kwargs (`break_long_words=False` and removing `_handle_long_word`) are a product decision with no statement in the parent tree. This is the measured boundary of evidence-driven repair.

protocol: single-parent commits from three external repositories; ONLY the fix commit's test files are copied onto a /dev/shm worktree of the parent; no source diff, patch, commit message, or issue text is read by the engine; a repair counts only when the copied tests pass AND the project's own suite fails no more than it did on the untouched parent
regression_note: regressions_encountered counts candidates REJECTED during search for making the fix test worse (pluggy@50585e0), none of which reached a final patch. regressions_introduced_into_a_project_suite counts final patches that leave a project suite with MORE failures than its untouched baseline. Measured by comparing after_repair_failures to baseline_failures per wall; 0 walls qualify.

rows.wall: an undocumented argument must still get a help row
empty envvar == absent envvar, and a sequence envvar names every member
a second interrupt while reporting must not replace the decided outcome
help option names must keep declaration order: `set()` is used where the returned list order is part of the contract
wrapping must not break hyphenated words: the repo states this policy in `utils.py` and omits it at the `TextWrapper` construction in `formatting.py`
an empty parameter payload must not leave a trailing separator
a suffix cardinality of zero selects nothing and must be refused
a documented default that is only reachable behind a feature flag
two co-required contracts inside one test: arity and state
the recorded distribution must be dropped with the plugin
